title: SPXL timing-signal search: pre-registration
governing_document: research/PREREGISTRATION.md (this file is its machine-readable copy of Part 2; the .md governs if they disagree)

constraints.no_technical_analysis: No input built from the direction, trend, momentum or moving average of SPXL, the S&P 500 or any other price. Valuation ratios as levels only. Realised volatility only as a sign-blind risk measure (inside C01). Correlations with past returns are diagnostics only.
constraints.seal: No predictive statistic using an outcome window ending after 2007-12-31 before the Test phase. Test-period predictor values may be stored but not summarised beyond missing counts.
constraints.fred_key: spxlcast.env.fred_api_key(); never printed, logged or placed in exception messages

readme_full_sample_1990_2026: Retired rating score: 6-month Spearman with SPXL excess return -0.03 (90% CI -0.22 to +0.17); BUY months -4.2 points vs rest (-18.0 to +9.6); 12 SELL months (Aug-Sep 1998, Oct-Dec 2000, Oct 2008-Mar 2009, Mar 2020) followed by +39% average; no threshold worked in both halves; BUY 83% of months 2008-2021, HOLD 95% since 2022

Leverage-cost hurdle: high-cost months +9.4 points vs rest (-5.6 to +24.4), low-cost -4.1 (-16.2 to +8.0); research brief records its full-sample 6-month rank correlation was seen (about -0.03); predicted cost 13.1% vs realised 14.4% on SPXL
VIX spikes followed by strong rebounds (1998, 2008-09, 2020) noticed: any VIX-level result (C10, C11, C12, partly C01) is not a clean test
Drawdown-risk levels: 20% dip within 3 months followed 8.8/22.4/35.4% at low/normal/elevated (11.7/24.5/42.5% predicted); SPXL-only since 2009 14/25/27%
Forecast distribution: 90% bands held 91-93%; CRPS 3-15% better than naive lognormal; mean PIT 0.54-0.57; dip chance 4-6 points high at 3-6 months
Fundamentals drift with curve, HY, CPI>3.5% and Sahm penalties: 6-month CRPS skill vs constant 7% +0.4% (-0.9% to +1.7%); HY penalty inactive before 2023-09
Drift backtest 1881-2026: correlation 0.22/0.47/0.60 at 1/5/10 years; valuation term added nothing; since 1990 drift 4.8%/yr low at 1 year; S&P 500 about 15.4%/yr over 2016-09..2026-06
parameters_fitted_on_test_period: 0.75% swap spread and tracking noise (SPXL since 2009)
VIX3M/VIX6M imputation before 2008 (log fit on 2008-2026; feeds C11 and C12 before 2008)
exposure_ledger.general_knowledge: Judge and proposers (language models) know 2008-2026 history: 2008-09 crisis, zero lower bound 2009-2015 and 2020-2021, 2020 crash/rebound/claims spike, strong returns at high valuations in the 2010s, 2021-23 inflation and 2022 rate shock and bear market, April 2020 negative oil price, missing October 2025 CPI. Mitigation: signs and definitions from pre-2008 literature, fixed now.
exposure_ledger.training_window_is_published_evidence: BTZ VRP sample is exactly 1990-2007; Cooper-Priestley, Ang-Bekaert and Welch-Goyal overlap it; training results are replication only
judge_opened: code: spxlcast/assess.py, spxlcast/evaluation.py, spxlcast/rating.py, spxlcast/env.py, spxlcast/data._fred_api, scripts/backtest_rating.py, config values
date range and fetch time of output/backtest/rating_inputs.pkl
FRED series metadata and ALFRED vintage dates (no values)
exposure_ledger.judge_computed: calendar quantities only (origin counts, effective_n, power); no statistic using predictors or outcomes
exposure_ledger.proposers_opened: README.md and code signatures only (scripts/backtest_drift.load_shiller, spxlcast.data._fred_api); no data or results files; no statistics

calendar.sessions: trading days of scripts/backtest_rating.build_daily(inputs, Config()) from the pinned rating_inputs.pkl (^SP500TR calendar)
calendar.origin: last session of each calendar month (backtest_rating.month_end_positions), 1990-01-31..2026-08-31
calendar.t_minus: the session immediately before the origin; daily market inputs of C01-C10 use values dated on or before t-; C11 and C12 use data dated t as in the backtest
calendar.position: decision at origin t implemented at the close of t; outcome window sessions t+1..t+h

pinned_inputs.output/research/predictor_inputs.pkl: downloaded once in the Train phase; SHA-256 recorded in research/TRAIN_REPORT.md

definitions.R_bill: prod over i=t+1..t+h of (1 + tbill_ret_i) - 1; tbill_ret = previous day's DGS3MO / 252 (build_daily)
definitions.Y: fund[t+h]/fund[t] - 1 - R_bill(t,h); fund = synthetic 3x through 2008-12-31, SPXL from 2009-01-02 (backtest excess_h)
definitions.D20: 1 if min over i=t+1..t+63 of fund[i]/fund[t] <= 0.8 else 0 (backtest real_dd20_63)

split.train_origins: month-ends from 1990-01-31 whose window's last session <= 2007-12-31
split.test_origins: month-ends from 2008-01-31 whose window's last session <= 2026-09-25
split.embargo: origins between the two belong to neither

candidates.name: Variance risk premium
candidates.definition: VIX(t-)^2/12 - RV21(t-); RV21 = sum over the 21 sessions ending at t- of (100*ln(G_i/G_{i-1}))^2, G = ^GSPC close; percent squared per month
candidates.exposure: partial: uses the VIX; premium negative after crashes (2008, 2020 known)
candidates.ta_flag: realised variance used only as a sign-blind risk measure (allowed, flagged)
candidates.rationale: Variance premium proxies aggregate risk aversion and precedes a high equity premium at 1-6 months, peaking near a quarter; for a fixed VIX a higher premium also means lower expected drag for a 3x fund

candidates.name: Real-time output gap
candidates.definition: INDPRO vintage in effect on origin date t (realtime_start=realtime_end=t); m = latest observation month; OLS ln IP_k = a + b*k + c*k^2 over months from max(1948-01, first observation) through m; GAP = residual at m; re-estimated at every origin
candidates.lag: vintage in effect at t (G.17 mid-month; m normally origin month minus one)
candidates.rationale: Countercyclical risk premia: output above trend marks low expected returns; real-time gap predicts excess returns at 1-12 months on pre-2008 data

candidates.name: 12-month change in the 3-month Treasury yield
candidates.definition: DGS3MO(t-) - DGS3MO(t'-), t' = the origin 12 month-ends earlier; percentage points
candidates.ta_flag: none (interest rate; 12-month change chosen so no moving-average construct appears)
candidates.rationale: Short rate above its level a year ago marks tightening; the short rate is the most robust short-horizon predictor with a negative sign

candidates.name: Term spread
candidates.exposure: inverted-curve penalty was inside the full-sample drift test (not isolated)
candidates.rationale: Steep curve marks early-cycle, high risk premia; term structure forecasts excess stock returns; weak out of sample

candidates.name: Default spread (Baa minus Aaa)
candidates.definition: DBAA(t-) - DAAA(t-); percentage points; level only
candidates.lag: dated on or before t-; not revised
candidates.exposure: close to clean (HY penalty could not fire before 2023-09)
candidates.rationale: High in bad times, tracks the business-cycle component of expected returns; sign set by the risk-premium channel because the primary target is a simple excess return; variance channel tested by C10/C11

candidates.name: CPI inflation, year on year
candidates.definition: CPIAUCNS vintage in effect on origin date t; m = latest observation month; ln(CPI_m/CPI_{m-12}); if CPI_{m-12} missing carry forward the previous origin's value; never interpolate. Fallback if ALFRED fails: m = latest published month <= origin month minus one
candidates.lag: vintage at t (about 10-15 days after the reference month)
candidates.exposure: 2021-23 inflation and 2022 bear market known; CPI>3.5% penalty inside the drift test
candidates.rationale: High inflation precedes low real and excess returns (proxy hypothesis, tighter policy, higher volatility); weak out of sample

candidates.name: Net share of banks tightening C&I lending standards
candidates.definition: FRED DRTSCILM from the latest observation usable at t, held constant between releases; an observation dated at the start of quarter q is usable from the last session of the first month after quarter q ends (e.g. 1990-04-01 usable from 1990-07-31)
candidates.lag: conservative rule above; QA: for observations whose first ALFRED vintage is within 120 days of the observation date, the usable date must be >= that vintage date, else all usable dates move one month later
candidates.exposure: clean apart from general knowledge; the returns paper's sample includes 2008
candidates.rationale: Tightening credit supply precedes slower lending and output; tighter standards predict lower aggregate returns at one quarter to a year
citations: Bassett, Chosak, Driscoll and Zakrajsek 2014 JME

candidates.name: Initial jobless claims, year on year
candidates.definition: w = latest week-ending Saturday with w + 5 days <= t; ln(sum ICNSA weeks w-3..w) - ln(sum ICNSA weeks w-55..w-52)
sources: FRED ICNSA (NSA, from 1967-01-07; latest vintage; ALFRED only from 2009)
candidates.lag: 5 days after week end (Thursday release); one small advance revision accepted
candidates.exposure: 2008 and 2020 spikes known; 2020 capped by the composite clip
candidates.rationale: Timeliest hard labour series and a leading indicator; rising layoffs mark recession onsets where drawdowns and volatility concentrate; weak and state-dependent prior
citations: Stock and Watson 1989 NBER Macro Annual

candidates.name: Excess CAPE yield
candidates.definition: q = backtest_rating.reported_quarter(t); m = latest CPIAUCNS month in the vintage at t; CAPE = (P(t-)/CPI_m) / mean over k=q-119..q of (E_k/CPI_k); RR10 = DGS10(t-)/100 - ((CPI_m/CPI_{m-120})^(1/10) - 1); ECY = 1/CAPE - RR10; P = ^GSPC close; E = Shiller trailing 12-month earnings; Shiller's own CAPE / ECY columns not used; level only
candidates.lag: earnings: last reported quarter (quarter end + 2 months); CPI: vintage at t; price and yield: t-
candidates.exposure: partial: valuation drift added no 6-month skill; valuation term added nothing 1881-2026; 2010s known
candidates.rationale: Cheap equities relative to real bond yields should earn more; strong at 5-10 years, weak at 1-6 months; valuation baseline with low prior

candidates.name: Implied variance (VIX squared)
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: VIX spikes followed by rebounds seen; hurdle (mostly VIX) seen to have no timing value
candidates.rationale: 3x fund log growth loses about 3x index variance per year; premium does not rise in proportion to variance, so high implied variance should mark worse typical SPXL outcomes; sign contested (Martin 2017)

candidates.name: Leverage-cost hurdle (spxlcast/assess.py)
candidates.definition: column hurdle of the pinned rating_backtest.csv at origin t: exp((fees + 2*(3m bill + 0.75%))/3 + 1.5*sigma_1y^2) - 1 via spxlcast.assess.leverage_cost
candidates.lag: data dated t, as in the backtest
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: full-sample tercile results and (per brief) rank correlation about -0.03 seen
candidates.rationale: Model's own cost measure; higher hurdle should mark worse times to hold SPXL; in excess returns it is in effect a volatility measure

candidates.name: Retired rating score (spxlcast/rating.py)
candidates.definition: column score of the pinned rating_backtest.csv at origin t: mean of clip(annualised 6-month median excess return / 15%) and clip(annualised Sharpe-like ratio / 0.5), full model, no news
candidates.lag: data dated t, as in the backtest
candidates.exposure: NOT CLEAN: full-sample 6-month rank correlation -0.03 and half-sample threshold behaviour seen

composite.z: (x_jt - mu_j) / sd_j; mu_j, sd_j (ddof=1) over parameter-window month-ends where x_j is available
composite.formula: mean over available members of clip(s_j * z_jt, -3, 3)
composite.weights: equal, fixed now; no fitting, no dropping after the freeze

from_predictor_values_at_parameter_windo: mu_j, sd_j for C01-C09 (reported for C10-C12)
tau_j = 33.33rd percentile of s_j*x_j per candidate (secondary economic table)
c = median IVAR; w_bar = mean of min(1, c/IVAR)
train_sets.train_outcome_statistics: computed and reported as replication only; may not change anything

primary_test.sample: test origins where predictor and target are available
primary_test.n_eff: spxlcast.evaluation.effective_n(session positions of the sample's origins, 126)
primary_test.p_one_sided: 1 - Phi(z); p = 1 if r undefined or n_eff <= 4
primary_test.correction: Holm step-down, family-wise alpha 0.05 over K = 13

secondary_tests.replication: primary test and F2-F7 on train origins, labelled published-sample replication

economic_test.rule: at each test origin 2008-01-31..2026-07-31 hold the realised fund (SPXL) from close t to the next month-end close if COMP_t >= tau, else T-bills (tbill_ret); last holding ends 2026-08-31 close; 223 monthly holdings, sessions 2008-02-01..2026-08-31
economic_test.switch_cost: 0.10% of portfolio per switch, charged on the first day of the new holding

benchmarks.BH: buy-and-hold realised fund, same sessions, no cost
benchmarks.MIX_w: w SPXL + (1-w) T-bills rebalanced monthly, w = rule's fraction of the 223 months in SPXL, cost 0.10% x |weight traded|

metrics.Sharpe: mean/sd of daily (return - tbill_ret) x sqrt(252)
metrics.max_drawdown: max over days of 1 - W_t / running max W

pass_all_of.E4: Sharpe(rule) > Sharpe(BH) within sessions 2008-02-01..2016-12-30 and within 2017-01-03..2026-08-31

economic_test.also_applied_to: every candidate passing the primary test, with its own tau_j (same criteria); all 12 candidates reported as a secondary table
secondary_descriptive: composite rule with 0 and 25 bp switching costs, and with threshold at the train median
stationary bootstrap (Politis-Romano) 90% intervals for Sharpe and CAGR differences vs BH: paired monthly holding-period returns, mean block 6 months, 10000 resamples, seed 20260927
vol-managed exposure w_t = min(1, c/IVAR_t), rest T-bills, monthly, 0.10% x |weight traded|, vs BH and constant w_bar (not clean: VIX level)
time in SPXL, switches, turnover, total costs

verdict.condition: primary Holm pass AND economic pass
verdict.label: Timing signal confirmed
Predictive, not usable by the registered rule

verdict.condition: composite economic pass, no primary pass
verdict.label: Not confirmed (gain could be luck); candidate for a new pre-registration on future data only

robustness_labels.episode-dependent: one-sided p > 0.10 when any one episode's origins are left out
robustness_labels.one half only: r not positive in both halves (origins 2008-01..2016-12 and 2017-01..2026-02)

sanity_checks: seal: no outcome window ending after 2007-12-31 loaded before Test (code guard + unit test)
pinned hashes match; predictor_inputs.pkl and train_params.json match TRAIN_REPORT.md
point in time: truncation invariance at 20 train month-ends per candidate; synthetic unit tests for CPI and INDPRO vintages, SLOOS usable date, claims Thursday rule, Shiller earnings lag
target reproduction vs pinned CSV (excess_h, sp_h - tbill_h, real_dd20_63), tolerance 1e-9: train origins in Train phase (read through the seal), all origins in Test phase
legacy reproduction (Test): score full-sample 6-month Spearman = -0.03 +/- 0.01, else fix as deviation before interpreting
synthetic fund vs SPXL daily correlation >= 0.99 where both exist
coverage of every candidate and COMP at train and test origins (expected >= 95%; SLOOS from 1990-07); test coverage < 90% flags that test
standardisation: mu_j, sd_j reported, no zero sd; members available per month
descriptives and plots of predictors (train only until unsealed)
TA diagnostic: train-period Spearman of each candidate and COMP with trailing 1/3/6/12-month S&P 500 price return (reported only)
collinearity: train-period Spearman matrix of the 12 candidates

robustness (Test): halves; leave out origins 2008-01..2009-06, 2019-09..2020-06, 2021-07..2022-12 in turn; moving-block bootstrap 90% interval for r (blocks of 12 origins, 10000, seed 20260927); COMP with expanding-window z (from 1990-01, minimum 60 months); partial Spearman of passing predictors controlling for ln VIX(t-) and DGS3MO(t-); synthetic spread 0.25% and 1.25%
look log: every run appends UTC time, phase, command, spec hashes and git describe --always --dirty to output/research/look_log.csv
always_reported: research/RESULTS.md and output/research/test/*: 13 primary tests (r, n, n_eff, 90% interval, raw and Holm p, pass/fail); F2-F7; train replication; composite economic test with benchmarks and E1-E4; secondary economic tables; all sanity checks; deviations; look-log summary; verdict in the registered words, including 'No timing signal found'

phases.1_build: scripts/research_signals.py (build, train, test) and tests/test_research_seal.py, tests/test_research_pit.py, tests/test_research_stats.py; no outcomes loaded
phases.2_train: download predictor_inputs.pkl; build all predictors; set train quantities; train-side checks and replication; write output/research/train_params.json and research/TRAIN_REPORT.md with both hashes
phases.3_test: py scripts/research_signals.py test --unseal <SHA-256 of research/PREREGISTRATION.md>; run once

code_guard: outcome loader truncates the daily frame at 2007-12-31 before any outcome is computed unless unsealed; unseal requires token == SHA-256 of PREREGISTRATION.md, both file hashes match PREREG_HASH.txt, train_params.json exists and matches TRAIN_REPORT.md; legacy predictor loader reads only date, pos, hurdle, score and checks the pinned hash; CSV outcome columns only via the target-reproduction check through the same seal
deviation_policy: record in research/DEVIATIONS.md with reason, date, before/after unsealing; before unsealing only data or code reasons, never train results; after unsealing only bug fixes, reporting original and corrected results; an unbuildable candidate is 'not tested', K stays 13, p = 1

excluded.oil price change: price momentum of a commodity (owner's no-momentum rule, read conservatively)
excluded.credit spread change, GZ EBP change: moves with past equity returns; EBP not point in time
excluded.relative bill rate (rate minus 12-month: replaced by 12-month change to avoid a moving-average construct
excluded.BAA10Y: mixes credit and maturity; Baa-Aaa is canonical
excluded.cay: recursive DOLS on NIPA/Z.1 vintages; stale; wealth moves with equity prices
excluded.Sahm real-time: designed 2019 with hindsight; overlaps C08; inside tested drift
excluded.TED, ISM PMI, OECD CLI: discontinued, not on FRED, or embeds share prices
excluded.HAR ex-ante VRP, realised-variance scali: one definition per idea; realised variance only inside C01
